neet_che_u09_t00_1.working: The modern periodic law (Moseley) says properties are periodic functions of atomic number.

neet_che_u09_t00_2.working: 1-1-5 gives un-un-pent plus the suffix -ium, so the name is Ununpentium.

neet_che_u09_t00_3.working: Period 4 fills 4s (1 orbital), 3d (5) and 4p (3). That is 9 orbitals holding 18 electrons.

neet_che_u09_t00_4.working: A is true: the lanthanoids are placed separately at the bottom. R is false: lanthanoids belong to period 6 and fill the 4f orbitals; 5f describes the actinoids.

neet_che_u09_t00_5.working: Statement I is incorrect: period 3 fills only 3s and 3p, not 3d. Statement II is incorrect: Moseley found that the square root of the frequency is proportional to Z, not the frequency itself.
